takeaway: Mercor's CEO says it reached $3B in run-rate revenue. Platform-owned agent repos led the day: Vercel's ui gained 1,756 stars and Google Chrome's modern-web-guidance 1,473. Scorecard rows are now frozen once published.

findings.heading: Mercor: $3B run-rate revenue
findings.text: Announcing a $750M Series D at a $20B valuation, CEO Brendan Foody wrote that Mercor scaled from $1M to $3B in run-rate revenue in 27 months.

findings.heading: vercel-labs/ui: +1,756 stars in a day
findings.text: A library of behaviors for agents to build user interfaces, created Oct 26, went from 2,258 to 4,014 stars.

findings.heading: Google Chrome's guidance for coding agents
findings.text: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src, which keeps coding agents current on web best practices, gained 1,473 stars, to 5,080, with 389 open issues.

findings.heading: meta/astryx cools sharply
findings.text: It gained 671 stars, down from 1,375 the day before: its slowest day since it entered the radar.

findings.heading: Scorecard rows are frozen
findings.text: Each forecast's score is now stored the first day it is scored, so published rows no longer change. The Nov 7 forecast scored 0.46 on its top 100, with 5 of its top 15 picks right.

caveats: Mercor's figure is the CEO's own post; its press release gives no revenue figure.
Scorecard rows up to Nov 7 were frozen at today's values, so Nov 5 shows 0.47 rather than the 0.45 first published.
Hacker News and npm remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
